profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to everyone in every organization you belong to.
profile.pictureHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 2 MB

password.title: Password
password.description: Used to sign in to every organization on this instance.
password.revokeOthersDescription: Everywhere else you are signed in has to sign in again with the new password.
password.changedAndRevoked: Password changed. Every other session was signed out.

email.title: Email address
email.description: Where sign-in links, invitations and notices are sent.
email.confirmed: Your new address is confirmed and is now the one you sign in with.
email.requested: If {requested} can be used, a confirmation link is on its way there. Your address stays {email} until you follow it.

security.title: Security
security.description: Ways to prove it is you, beyond your password. They apply to every organization on this instance.

refusal.authenticator: {organizations} {count, plural, one {requires} other {require}} two-factor authentication; add a passkey or keep your authenticator app
refusal.passkey: {organizations} {count, plural, one {requires} other {require}} two-factor authentication; add another passkey or an authenticator app before removing this one

twoFactor.title: Authenticator app
twoFactor.enabledDescription: A code from your app is asked for after your password.
twoFactor.enabledWithBackupCodes: A code from your app is asked for after your password. {count, plural, one {# backup code} other {# backup codes}} left.
twoFactor.disabledDescription: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
twoFactor.regenerated: New backup codes created. The old ones no longer work.

verify.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
verify.scan: Scan the code with an authenticator app, such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
verify.cantScan: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead:
verify.codeDescription: Two-factor authentication is only turned on once this code is accepted.

backupCodes.title: Save your backup codes
backupCodes.description: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator app. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
backupCodes.label: Backup codes

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password. A passkey is used instead of a second factor.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.alreadyOnDevice: This device already holds a passkey for your account
passkeys.browserFailed: Your browser could not create a passkey
passkeys.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? You will no longer be able to sign in with it.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Everywhere you are signed in. Sign out of anything you do not recognise, then change your password.
sessions.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other sessions
sessions.othersSignedOut: Every other session was signed out

danger.title: Delete account
danger.description: Deleting your account removes you from every organization at once, signs you out everywhere and cannot be undone.
danger.soleOwner: You are the only owner of these organizations. Make someone else an owner of each, or delete it, before you delete your account.
danger.auditNote: What you did stays in the audit logs under the name and address you had, as the record of what happened.

setup.title: Secure your account
setup.description: {organization} requires two-factor authentication. Set up an authenticator app or add a passkey to continue.

nudge.title: Protect your account
nudge.description: Add a passkey or an authenticator app, so a password alone is not enough to sign in as you.

validation.pictureInvalid: Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 2 MB
validation.passwordUnchanged: Choose a password different from your current one
validation.secondFactorRequired: Enter a code from your authenticator app or a backup code
validation.codeInvalid: That is not a valid code
validation.enrollmentCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your app

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.passwordNotChanged: Your password could not be changed
errors.sameEmail: That is already your email address
errors.emailNotChanged: Your email address could not be changed
errors.secondFactorInvalid: That code is not valid. Use your authenticator app or a backup code.
errors.twoFactorNotEnabled: Two-factor authentication is not turned on
errors.twoFactorAlreadyEnabled: Two-factor authentication is already turned on
errors.twoFactorSetupFailed: Two-factor authentication could not be set up
errors.twoFactorCodeInvalid: That code is not valid. Check the time on your device and try again.
errors.twoFactorNotDisabled: Two-factor authentication could not be turned off
errors.backupCodesNotCreated: New backup codes could not be created
errors.passkeySessionNotFresh: For your security, sign out and sign in again before adding a passkey.
errors.passkeyNotStarted: A passkey cannot be added right now
errors.passkeyNotAdded: The passkey could not be added
errors.passkeyNotRenamed: The passkey could not be renamed
errors.passkeyNotRemoved: The passkey could not be removed
errors.currentSession: This is the session you are using. Log out to end it.
errors.soleOwner: You are the only owner of {organizations}. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.passwordAndCodeRequired: Enter your password and a code
